notes: Reviewed creator profile for Meta AI. Seeds are canonical Meta-owned URLs plus the official Meta Llama distribution org on Hugging Face; the tool describes and never fetches them.

terminology.family: The open-weight family is Llama, with generations such as Llama 3 and Llama 3.1 and sizes given in parameters (8B, 70B, 405B).
terminology.release: A specific Llama model, e.g. Llama 3.1 70B Instruct. Base and Instruct are variants of a release.
terminology.distribution: Llama weights are distributed under the Llama Community License; official weights are published to the meta-llama organization on Hugging Face.
terminology.serving: Meta serves Llama through partners; the weights themselves are downloadable rather than served from a single first-party API.

naming_rules.subject: family
naming_rules.rule: The family is Llama. Record generation and parameter size as attributes; do not split sizes into separate families.
naming_rules.example: Llama 3.1 70B is the 70B size of the Llama 3.1 generation.

naming_rules.subject: release
naming_rules.rule: Record base vs instruction-tuned as a variant of the release, not as a separate family.
naming_rules.example: Llama 3.1 70B Instruct is the Instruct variant of Llama 3.1 70B.

naming_rules.subject: size
naming_rules.rule: Parameter counts use Meta's own suffix form (8B, 70B, 405B); keep them verbatim.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Meta AI's official blog; authoritative for Llama announcements and research.
source_catalog.verification: Official Meta AI blog under the Meta-owned ai.meta.com host.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Meta AI's site sections for Llama and resources; authoritative for model overviews and licensing.
source_catalog.verification: Llama and resource sections under the Meta-owned ai.meta.com host.

source_catalog.trust_notes: The official Meta Llama organization on Hugging Face; the canonical distribution point for Llama weights and model cards. Hosted by Hugging Face but the meta-llama org is Meta's own.
source_catalog.verification: Official meta-llama organization on huggingface.co, Meta's stated weight-distribution channel.

notes: Attribute Llama releases to the single Llama family; record generation, size, and variant as attributes.
Take model cards from the official meta-llama Hugging Face org, not from re-uploads by third parties.
Record licensing (Llama Community License) from a Meta-owned page, not from a mirror.

ambiguities.note: Many third parties re-host Llama weights on Hugging Face and elsewhere.
ambiguities.guidance: Treat only the meta-llama org as first-party; a mirror is a newly discovered source that must pass review.

ambiguities.note: A single size ships as both a base and an instruction-tuned model.
ambiguities.guidance: Record them as variants of one release; do not merge their benchmark numbers.

ambiguities.note: Meta distributes weights rather than serving Llama from one first-party API.
ambiguities.guidance: Record third-party serving as separate deployments; do not invent a Meta-hosted serving platform.
